# SecuredTokenTransfer

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/aae683920cd57dc96d920c3e2d788e226f098aef/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/common/SecuredTokenTransfer.sol)

**Title:** SecuredTokenTransfer - Secure token transfer.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Functions

<a id="transfertoken-address-address-uint256"></a>

### transferToken

Transfers a token and returns a boolean if it was a success

<i>

It checks the return data of the transfer call and returns true if the transfer was successful.
     It doesn't check if the `token` address is a contract or not.

</i>

```solidity
function transferToken(address token, address receiver, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool transferred);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| token | `address` | Token that should be transferred |
| receiver | `address` | Receiver to whom the token should be transferred |
| amount | `uint256` | The amount of tokens that should be transferred |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| transferred | `bool` | Returns true if the transfer was successful |
